title: Event envelope event.v1 (DRAFT, issue #242; not authoritative until the ADR is accepted)
description: One append-only log event (ADR-0012). Envelope and payload keys are closed per known type. A payload never carries a secret-shaped value or a raw-log field (D6). A reader meeting an unknown type skips it (D3); this schema only describes the known types, so an unknown type fails validation here. Ordering and causality rules (D5) need the whole log and are not expressible in this per-event schema.

noSecret.description: Rejects secret-shaped values (private key header, common token prefixes, cloud key ids, bearer values, JWTs, and key=value pairs naming a password, secret, token or API key). Generic high-entropy strings are NOT detected here; the writer full secret scanner (D6) must cover them.

tier.description: Computed by the host (ADR-0009), never taken from an agent.

relPath.description: Relative to a named root; no absolute paths, no "." or ".." segments.

evidenceList.description: References into the evidence store, never content.

allOf.description: One plain sentence written by the host: 300 characters or fewer, no control characters, newlines or Unicode line/paragraph separators (U+0085, U+2028, U+2029).

usage.description: Counters reported by the adapter, numbers or null only, so no text can leak through a value. Counter names equal (any case) to a guarded name such as secret, token or password are rejected; other names are not vetted, so the writer full scanner (D6) must still cover them.
